rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a daytime daycare institution for young children.

example.english: I take my daughter to the nursery in the morning and pick her up after work.
example.traditional: 我個女朝早送咗去幼兒中心，放工先接返佢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 neoi2 ziu1 zou2 sung3 zo2 heoi3 jau3 ji4 zung1 sam1 fong3 gung1 sin1 zip3 faan1 keoi5

rows.note: Use this for a room in a home set aside for children, rather than a childcare institution.

example.english: When we renovated, we specially set aside a room as the nursery.
example.traditional: 裝修嗰陣，我哋特登留咗間房做兒童房。
example.jyutping: zong1 sau1 go2 zan6 ngo5 dei6 dak6 dang1 lau4 zo2 gaan1 fong4 zou6 ji4 tung4 fong4

rows.note: Use this for a place where young plants are grown or sold for planting elsewhere.

example.english: This nursery has many young trees suitable for planting in Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 呢間苗圃有好多適合香港種嘅幼樹。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 miu4 pou2 jau5 hou2 do1 sik1 hap6 hoeng1 gong2 zung2 ge3 jau3 syu6
